metaTitle: About Harbour Tank Co | Oil Tank Replacement Experts in St. John's and the Avalon Peninsula
metaDescription: Harbour Tank Co replaces and removes home heating oil tanks in St. John's and across the Avalon. Free written estimates, straight CAD prices and a 24/7 line.
heroSub: We replace and remove residential heating oil tanks for homes in St. John's and across the Avalon Peninsula, with the price in writing before anyone shows up and a real person on the phone when your tag runs out.
storyHtml:
Harbour Tank Co exists for one reason: most people in St. John's don't think about their oil tank until the day the delivery driver won't fill it. Every registered tank carries a small metal HOST tag with an expiry date stamped on it, and once that month passes the fuel company can't legally deliver. That tends to happen in the coldest week of the year, with the house going cold and nobody sure who to call. We wanted to be the number you call, and to make the whole thing a lot less stressful than it usually is.

We handle oil tank replacement, oil tank removal and fibreglass and double-wall upgrades for houses across the Northeast Avalon, Conception Bay South and Conception Bay North. A 200-gallon steel tank is $3,200 installed and fibreglass is $3,850, both with the old tank hauled away, and an outdoor tank removal on its own is $500. If your tag has already run out or there's oil on the snow, our 24/7 emergency line gets a real person on the phone any hour.

The way we work is plain. Someone comes out, looks at the tank, the stand, the pad and the furnace line, and puts a price in writing for free. Once you approve it we book the swap, usually within the week, and the installer's licensed inspector tags and registers the new system so your fuel company can fill you again. You also get the confirmation of registration that insurers, lawyers and realtors ask for when a house changes hands.

We're based in St. John's and cover Mount Pearl, Paradise, Conception Bay South, Torbay, Portugal Cove-St. Philip's and Bay Roberts, with Spaniard's Bay, Harbour Grace and Carbonear close by. You won't find a wall of awards here or a big number of tanks we claim to have swapped. What you will get is a written estimate you can hold us to and a properly tagged tank at the end of it. If you'd like every number laid out before you pick up the phone, the cost guide has them all.

values.title: The price is in writing before we start
values.desc: We check the tank, stand, pad and lines, then put the number on paper. What you sign is what you pay unless you change the job partway through.

values.title: We talk like neighbours, not salespeople
values.desc: You'll get a straight answer on steel versus fibreglass, or on whether your tank even needs to come out yet. If the job can safely wait until morning, we'll say so and save you the after-hours cost.

values.title: Nobody gets left without heat
values.desc: A refused delivery or a leak in January isn't a Monday-morning problem. The 24/7 line is answered by a person, and anyone already out of oil goes to the front of the line.

values.title: Done by the book, not just done
values.desc: Every crew at your door is insured, and the installer's licensed inspector tags and registers each new system with the province. The old tank is emptied, dismantled and disposed of inside the 30 days NLR 60/03 gives you, and you get the paperwork your insurer and your lawyer will ask for.

faq.q: Is Harbour Tank Co a fuel company?
faq.a: No. We don't sell heating oil and we're not tied to any supplier. We replace and remove the tanks and get them tagged and registered, then you book your delivery with whoever you already buy from. That's also why we can tell you honestly whether a tank needs to come out or can wait.

faq.q: Who actually inspects and registers the new tank?
faq.a: A licensed inspector working with the installer. Under NLR 60/03 only the inspection for registration needs a licence, and that person tags the new system and files the registration with the province. You're left with the confirmation of registration, which insurers, lawyers and realtors often ask for.

If it's on the Avalon, most likely yes. We're based in St. John's and regularly work Mount Pearl, Paradise, Conception Bay South, Torbay, Portugal Cove-St. Philip's and Bay Roberts, with Spaniard's Bay, Harbour Grace and Carbonear close by. Call (709) 800-3117 or email info@harbourtank.ca and we'll tell you straight.
